scenario.name: r-cd-model-tool
scenario.description: continue_delegate typed tool form forwards an explicit model override to the delegate child.
scenario.notes: Alternate-model rows are blocked on karmaterminal/openclaw#1103 until the child runtime observes the requested model instead of inheriting gpt-5.5.
scenario.registryNotes: Local scratch conversion: runnable k6 scenario exercises typed continue_delegate with explicit model override; honest-limit if runtime observes fallback/inheritance.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: report the current model identity from runtime context and the nonce only. The requested model is intentionally omitted from the child task to prevent echo-based false PASS. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Observed child runtime model/provider byte from status/session metadata or child self-report backed by session metadata

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: requested-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Committed request byte showing continue_delegate model=<provider/model>

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when requested model byte and observed child runtime-context model byte match. The child task must not include the requested model; if the child reports UNKNOWN/fallback/inherited model or no child model byte, fold as HONEST-LIMIT-candidate with mismatch evidence, not as pass.

liveRunSafety.notes: Explicit model override row. Prevent echo-based false PASS by omitting requested model from the child task; if child observes UNKNOWN/fallback/inherited model, package as HONEST-LIMIT with mismatch evidence, not pass.
